preamble: In Sanskrit external and internal sandhi, a retroflex sibilant [ʂ] before a voiced stop becomes the retroflex stop [ɖ]. Voicing assimilation is combined with the same stop closure as in word-final position.
sources: Whitney, W. D. (1889). Sanskrit Grammar. Harvard University Press.
Burrow, T. (1955). The Sanskrit Language. Faber & Faber.
Macdonell, A. A. (1927). A Sanskrit Grammar for Students. Oxford University Press.
